title: Editor E0 task 12b, the member rail builder runs on nodes behind render_path_space_profile
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. getMemberLayoutRailData returns nodeLayout (ownerNodeLayout kind member) only while render_path_space_profile is on; MemberPageBuilderSwitch mounts NodePageBuilder (now takes kind, default space) when the data carries one and the type-keyed ProfilePageBuilder otherwise; NodeLayoutMount saves a member node document through saveMemberGridLayout (LIVE-1062). Switch off: no change. Next: the owner's profile preview and page render the node grid, then the importer and task 15 backfill.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/settings/rail-getters.ts','utf8').includes(\"renderPathEnabled('space_profile')\"))bad.push('member rail data not behind the switch');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/member-page-builder-switch.tsx','utf8').includes('NodePageBuilder'))bad.push('no member node builder switch');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/admin/modules/personal-layout-module.tsx','utf8').includes('MemberPageBuilderSwitch'))bad.push('rail module skips the switch');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1063: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when member node data is served without the switch or the rail module stops going through the builder switch. Behavior is member-page-builder-switch.test.tsx.
